1.web: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
1.asv: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:

2.web: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
2.asv: To know wisdom and instruction; To discern the words of understanding;

3.web: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
3.asv: To receive instruction in wise dealing, In righteousness and justice and equity;

4.web: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man:
4.asv: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion:

5.web: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
5.asv: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; And that the man of understanding may attain unto sound counsels:

6.web: to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
6.asv: To understand a proverb, and a figure, The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

7.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
7.asv: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge; Butthe foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

8.web: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
8.asv: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:

9.web: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
9.asv: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.

10.web: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
10.asv: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.

11.web: If they say, “Come with us, Let’s lay in wait for blood; let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause;
11.asv: If they say, Come with us, Let us lay wait for blood; Let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause;

12.web: let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
12.asv: Let us swallow them up alive as Sheol, And whole, as those that go down into the pit;

13.web: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
13.asv: We shall find all precious substance; We shall fill our houses with spoil;

14.web: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse.”
14.asv: Thou shalt cast thy lot among us; We will all have one purse:

15.web: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
15.asv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; Refrain thy foot from their path:

16.web: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
16.asv: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.

17.web: For in vain is the net spread in the sight of any bird:
17.asv: For in vain is the net spread In the sight of any bird:

18.web: but these lay wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
18.asv: And these lay wait for their own blood; They lurk privily for their own lives.

19.web: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
19.asv: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; It taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

20.web: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
20.asv: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street; She uttereth her voice in the broad places;

21.web: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
21.asv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse; At the entrance of the gates, In the city, she uttereth her words:

22.web: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
22.asv: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? And scoffers delight them in scoffing, And fools hate knowledge?

23.web: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
23.asv: Turn you at my reproof: Behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you; I will make known my words unto you.

24.web: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
24.asv: Because I have called, and ye have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man hath regarded;

25.web: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
25.asv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof:

26.web: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you;
26.asv: I also will laugh inthe day ofyour calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

27.web: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind; when distress and anguish come on you.
27.asv: When your fear cometh as a storm, And your calamity cometh on as a whirlwind; When distress and anguish come upon you.

28.web: Then will they call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;
28.asv: Then will they call upon me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they shall not find me:

29.web: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
29.asv: For that they hated knowledge, And did not choose the fear of Jehovah,

30.web: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
30.asv: They would none of my counsel, They despised all my reproof.

31.web: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
31.asv: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own devices.

32.web: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
32.asv: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them, And the careless ease of fools shall destroy them.

33.web: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
33.asv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely, And shall be quiet without fear of evil.
